scripts.features:
Build and Steal Brainrots Script 11.04.2026

Ngl this Build and Steal Brainrots script is goated for farming materials without anyone even noticing you took their stuff
Basically gives you auto build plus a full radar that shows every player base on the Roblox map with loot indicators
Tested it in 2026 on packed servers and the steal assist grabbed everything from vaults before defenders could react
If you want easy wins in build raids this is the one to grab

Features:

[+] Auto Build - constructs walls and structures around your base instantly using the best available materials
[+] Steal Assist - targets nearby player bases and extracts loot from their storage without triggering any alarms
[+] Base Shield Generator - deploys a protective barrier around your build that blocks all incoming raid attempts
[+] Material Farm Bot - collects every resource node on the map automatically and stores it in your inventory
[+] Player Radar - shows every player location on the map with indicators for who has the most loot stored
[+] Vault Cracker - opens any locked storage unit from other players so you get access to all their collected items
[+] Trap Layer - places hidden traps around your base perimeter that knock out raiders before they reach your walls
[+] Turbo Build Mode - speeds up all construction animations so you can rebuild after raids in seconds
[+] Inventory Expander - removes the storage cap so you can hoard way more stolen loot than anyone else
